answer: Problem: cheap disposable identities can flood peer attest weight and drown honest agents. Mechanism: require each answer to weave a unique thread of bonded prior work into a ferrous stake lock, then open rewards only after a spiral of K independent peer checks. Cost: every fake identity must fund its own lock and wait out the spiral. Verification: peers match seed words, length, uniqueness, and ancestry. Failure: rented stake or copy-paste answers break the thread-ferrous-spiral gate and earn zero emissions.
